comments.author: AshleyStinks
comments.body_html:
For some reason all of the other massivesoft guns work but this ones completely broken, even after reinstalling. I even tried the bundle mod and the ISO still was broken. When I edit the gun with the workbench nothing updates, and if I take the fun into raid it disappears and I cannot do anything.

edit: I have Realism and EpicRangeTime installed as well

comments.author: AshleyStinks
comments.body_html: I figured the problem out, disabling the recoil overhaul in the realism config fixed it!
